components.name: Subscription disclosure
components.html:
Preview and subscription details

Your one-time 7-day Premium Preview starts after your first personalized workout is ready. No payment required and no automatic charge. Afterward, keep your local workouts, logs, and progress. New personalized AI features and cloud sync require Premium.

Founder pricing is for the first 200 subscriptions in each offer. Standard pricing: $12.99/month or $119.99/year. Availability and local prices are confirmed in the app. Paid subscriptions renew automatically; manage or cancel in Apple ID settings.

narrative.overview:
DoThis uses a near-black field, logo-family green emphasis, and plain Work Sans typography. Short copy, open space, and genuine product evidence make the homepage easy to understand.

This records index.html, src/home.css, home.js, and the reviewed 390px and 1440px captures. The user's latest correction in docs/design/simple/DIRECTION.md supersedes the rejected photographic editorial direction. There is no approved comp. Other site destinations are outside this homepage record.
keyCharacteristics: One green accent on a near-black ground.
One font family and a clear reading hierarchy.
The unchanged logo and Coach screen as the only imagery.
Compact pricing, native disclosure, and no animation.

rules.name: The Green Emphasis Rule
rules.body: Use green for emphasis and interaction; keep the page ground neutral.

rules.name: The Plain Type Rule
rules.body: Use Work Sans for every website text role; express hierarchy through size, weight, and spacing.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Keep website surfaces flat. Use space and fine rules to separate content.

dos: Do preserve the approved logo, unchanged screenshot, and full-size inspection link.
Do keep the preview and no-charge disclosure directly below the download action.
Do retain visible focus, real links, native disclosure, and useful non-JavaScript content.
Do keep claims consistent with PRODUCT.md and the in-app purchase flow.
donts: Don't add decorative pictures, generated imagery, 3D models, or ornamental motion.
Don't restore the rejected editorial palette, display font, sport selectors, or repeated closing pitch.
Don't repaint the app screenshot or promote its internal colors into website tokens.
Don't treat other site destinations as redesigned by this record.
